title: Numerically-Exact Quantum-Simulation Approach for Two-Dimensional Spectroscopy of Open Quantum Systems
summary: Two-dimensional spectroscopy (2DS) is a powerful ultrafast technique for probing electronic and vibrational dynamics in complex microscopic systems. Extracting detailed information on system dynamics and system-bath interactions from 2DS experiments requires precise theoretical simulations for comparison, which motivates the development of numerically-exact and computationally-efficient simulation approaches.
